title: Gas Manager + Daily Cleanup + Capital Rotation Vision
summary: Built two new systems: (1) Gas auto-replenishment with worst-performer liquidation fallback, (2) Daily portfolio cleanup that re-scores all open positions via DexScreener and flushes trash (score <45 or PnL <-40%) to native gas. User also requested proactive 'arbitrage trading up' — continuously rotating capital from low-conviction to high-conviction positions.

what_happened.task: Implement gas management and portfolio hygiene for overnight operation
features_built: core/gas_manager.py — dual-strategy gas replenishment (USDC primary, liquidation fallback)
daily_portfolio_cleanup() — re-scores all positions, flushes trash → native gas
Main loop integration: gas check every 10 cycles, cleanup self-gates to 24h
what_happened.stale_position_found: BTC.b on Avalanche had 3,366 wei (dust) but position file showed full quantity — on-chain balance mismatch caused flush failure. Manually closed.

what_went_well: Worst-performer ranking formula (PnL×2 + score×0.5) correctly identifies dead weight
Daily cleanup correctly identified BTC.b at -100% PnL and attempted flush
Both systems are non-blocking — wrapped in try/except, never halt the main loop
what_went_wrong: BTC.b flush failed because position file quantity didn't match on-chain balance (dust remnant)
Need to add on-chain balance check before attempting flush sells
key_insights.root_cause: Position file quantities can drift from on-chain reality when partial sells or failed exits leave dust

patterns_extracted.description: Position file quantities can become stale vs on-chain balance. Always check actual on-chain token balance before attempting a sell, not just the stored quantity.
patterns_extracted.action: Before any sell, compare stored qty vs on-chain balance. Use min(stored, on-chain) as sell amount.

patterns_extracted.description: User directive: every capital movement should trend toward profitability. Gas should be funded by selling losers. Trash positions should become gas. Dead capital should be recycled. Never let stale positions sit idle.
patterns_extracted.action: Implemented in gas_manager.py and daily_portfolio_cleanup(). Future: proactive capital rotation.

patterns_extracted.description: Future feature: proactive 'arbitrage trading up' — if a held position scores 50 but a new candidate scores 85, sell the low-scorer to fund the high-scorer. This requires a conviction comparison engine that runs hourly alongside the position monitor.
patterns_extracted.action: Design a CapitalRotator that compares held position scores vs. top gem candidates and triggers swaps when delta exceeds threshold (e.g., 25+ point spread).

future_features.name: CapitalRotator
future_features.description: Hourly: re-score all held positions, compare against top 5 gem candidates. If candidate_score - position_score > 25 AND position is profitable or near-breakeven, sell position and enter candidate. Net effect: continuously trade up in conviction quality.

future_features.name: OnChainBalanceVerification
future_features.description: Before any flush/liquidation sell, verify actual on-chain token balance matches position file. Use min(stored, actual) to prevent 'insufficient balance' errors.

user_feedback.comments: User wants: (1) flush trash daily, (2) convert to gas across all chains, (3) always arbitrage trading up in capital value hourly/daily
